verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only external AI integrations: a local API, an MCP server, and an agents skill that you drop into Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools so they can act on Anytype data. Nothing shows an AI assistant built into the Anytype app itself that users can delegate tasks to. The chat API covers ordinary messaging, not an assistant, and the 'AI Agents' mention on GitHub points to AGENTS.md rather than an in-app assistant.
